  "domain_file": "(define (domain blocksworld)
  (:requirements :strips)
  ;; CONSTRAINT: The number of stacks is represented by a count object.
  ;; A stack is a tower whose base is on the table; its count is maintained by actions.
  ;; limit-ok is true for count0..count3, encoding the maximum of 3 stacks.
  ;; The post-action limit-ok precondition implements the 'once you start moving' constraint:
  ;; the initial state may violate the limit, but every action must result in at most 3 stacks.
  (:predicates
    (on ?x ?y)
    (on-table ?x)
    (clear ?x)
    (holding ?x)
    (arm-empty)
    (count ?x)
    (decrement ?x ?y)
    (increment ?x ?y)
    (limit-ok ?x)
  )
  ;; BEGIN ADD: pickup must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action pickup
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?c)
        (decrement ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (not (on-table ?b))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: putdown must leave at most 3 stacks
  (:action putdown
    :parameters (?b ?c ?d)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (count ?c)
        (increment ?c ?d)
        (limit-ok ?d)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on-table ?b)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (count ?c))
        (count ?d)
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: stack must not exceed 3 stacks
  (:action stack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?k)
    :precondition
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (count ?k)
        (limit-ok ?k)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (not (holding ?b))
        (not (clear ?c))
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
  ;; BEGIN ADD: unstack must not exceed 3 stacks
  (:action unstack
    :parameters (?b ?c ?k)
    :precondition
      (and
        (on ?b ?c)
        (clear ?b)
        (arm-empty)
        (count ?k)
        (limit-ok ?k)
      )
    :effect
      (and
        (holding ?b)
        (clear ?c)
        (not (on ?b ?c))
        (not (clear ?b))
        (not (arm-empty))
      )
  )
  ;; END ADD
)",
